shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone slab/pillar
animals in profile rendered in relief
repeated animal figures arranged in registers/clusters
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animal iconography on a large upright slab, with sinuous serpentine bodies, quadruped/reptilian creatures in profile and a discrete round disc motif set among them, and in both the creatures are packed in loose clusters rather than a single scene. However B has a clear ordered composition with a row of repeated arched/animal-head figures above a banded register and a large bird-like figure below, while A is a dense, non-registered tangle of coiling forms with no comparable horizontal band or repeated head-row, so the overall compositional scheme differs.
